name: vision_lightning_cls_bad
title: The same Lightning image classifier with six planted defects
origin: domain-vision round 1: the dirty twin of vision_lightning_cls

expected.why: LightningDataModule's own attributes are never initialised, so save_hyperparameters, the trainer reference and the hook bookkeeping all fail or silently do nothing
expected.gap: ISSUE_RULES 3/MLV701 resolves bases against torch.nn.Module and pytorch_lightning/lightning LightningModule only. pl.LightningDataModule is not in that set, so a DataModule that skips super().__init__() - which breaks save_hyperparameters() and the trainer wiring - is out of scope.

expected.why: Lightning has no loss to back-propagate, so with automatic optimisation the batch contributes nothing and the run trains on the hand-rolled update alone

expected.defect: training_step calls optimizer.zero_grad(), loss.backward() and optimizer.step() by hand with automatic optimisation still enabled
expected.why: Lightning applies its own update on top, so every batch is stepped twice with gradients that have already been consumed
Lightning steps the schedule once per epoch, so a one-cycle built for steps_per_epoch*epochs steps completes its whole cycle in twenty steps and the rest of the run trains at the floor learning rate

expected.defect: setup() builds all three datasets with the augmented training pipeline
expected.why: the validation and test images are randomly cropped, flipped and colour-jittered, so the monitored val_acc moves for reasons unrelated to the weights

expected.defect: the same one-pipeline-for-three-splits defect, on the test split
expected.why: setup() builds test_ds from the same augmented training pipeline, so a second finding here is a correct second instance of defect 2 rather than a new claim; it was not planted separately, which is what `acceptable` is for (docs/ACCURACY.md section 2)
the per-sample validation predictions come back in a different order each epoch
the augmentation draw, the head initialisation and the shuffling all move between runs

forbidden.why: the loaders are built inside the DataModule hooks, reached from main() under the __main__ guard
zero_grad IS called in the hand-rolled step, and Lightning owns it anyway
step() IS called in the hand-rolled step
Lightning puts the module in eval mode around validation_step
the head still returns logits and the criterion is still CrossEntropyLoss
the three splits are still three directories
the model is still a single torchvision backbone

gaps.what: MLV701 does not cover LightningDataModule: its documented base list is torch.nn.Module, pytorch_lightning.LightningModule and lightning.LightningModule, so a DataModule that skips super().__init__() is never reported
gaps.evidence: the MLV701 expected label above is a standing miss
